tldr: Biggest risk to the book: levered silver — it broke below $58 Thursday on the oil-led shift toward a possible 2026 Fed HIKE, but clawed back to ~$58 by Friday and still finished the week +~4.6%; silver moves 2-3x gold on hike expectations, so it cuts both ways around the 28-29 Jul FOMC. Trim/hedge into the print, don't add.

Master driver stays the US-Iran war (13th straight night of US strikes; Saudi Arabia struck Houthis in Yemen); oil topped ~$100 then eased ~4% to Brent ~$97 on peace-talk reports but held +>12% on the week, with the 27 Jul futures reopen biased higher — a de-escalation is the fastest catalyst to relieve silver, S-REITs and crypto at once.

HK-tech binary resolved UP: China's 24 Jul Politburo delivered stronger-than-expected stimulus language + an anti-'involution' pricing-law draft, and China fuelled the second-largest weekly EM-equity inflow of the year. Favor Tencent (southbound buying, buybacks) over Xiaomi.
Gold holds far better than silver (~$4,055 below a $4,130 high) — favor gold-heavy GDX over pure silver leverage while the war/inflation tug-of-war runs.

Rare earths: Trump's 20 Jul EO bars defense contractors from adversary-sourced materials (bullish MP/UUUU), but China's controls are suspended to 10 Nov (magnet exports +75% MoM) — accumulate ex-China names on weakness into the snap-back, not chase.

Smart money: Berkshire deployed ~$10B into Alphabet (still ~$344B cash); Burry is short NVDA/MU/AMAT (2 Jul Substack); Ackman added a ~$2.09B MSFT stake in Q1 and teased four new Q2 positions. Q2 13Fs due 14 Aug.

regime.label: Oil shock fades but rates & a firm dollar pressure metals into a hawkish-hold Fed
regime.oneLiner: Equities hold near highs on calm credit and low VIX, but an oil-led shift toward pricing a possible 2026 Fed HIKE lifted yields to a year-high ~4.71% and a firm dollar, pressuring metals (silver broke $58 then reclaimed it) — the US-Iran war escalation-vs-de-escalation is the swing into the 29 Jul FOMC, with the 24 Jul Politburo a fresh positive for HK tech.

topNews.actionable: The HK-tech binary resolved up — hold the core and favor Tencent on relative strength; watch for follow-through detail before adding.

topNews.actionable: The break wasn't decisive — but silver is the book's most rate-sensitive holding; hedge the silver-vs-gold spread into the FOMC rather than add leverage.
